description: Defines the ul_pusch_pdu_builder class for constructing and configuring PUSCH PDU messages in 5G NR protocol, including setting various parameters and options.

classes.name: ul_pusch_pdu_builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing and configuring UL PUSCH PDUs with various parameter setting methods.

methods.name: set_ue_specific_parameters
methods.description: Sets UE-specific parameters in the PUSCH PDU.

methods.name: set_bwp_parameters
methods.description: Sets BWP parameters such as resource block interval, subcarrier spacing, and cyclic prefix.

methods.name: set_information_parameters
methods.description: Sets information parameters like code rate, modulation, MCS index, and number of layers.

methods.name: set_transform_precoding_enabled_parameters
methods.description: Enables transform precoding with specified DMRS identity.

methods.name: set_transform_precoding_disabled_parameters
methods.description: Disables transform precoding with specified number of DMRS groups.

methods.name: set_dmrs_parameters
methods.description: Sets DMRS parameters including symbol positions, type, scrambling ID, NSCID, and ports.

methods.name: set_time_allocation_parameters
methods.description: Sets time allocation for the PUSCH.

methods.name: add_uci_part1_part2_correspondence
methods.description: Adds UCI part1 to part2 correspondence information.

methods.name: add_optional_pusch_data
methods.description: Adds optional data parameters to the PUSCH.

methods.name: add_optional_pusch_uci
methods.description: Adds optional UCI information to the PUSCH.

methods.name: set_context_vendor_specific
methods.description: Sets vendor-specific context for the PUSCH PDU.
